items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay said the team will not place Puka Nacua on IR due to roster mechanics, but the WR will still be out for a significant period of time with knee (MCL/PCL) and turf toe injuries.
items.why: Roster activation limits; still multi-week absence
items.implication: Rams WR depth thin; lean run-heavy; Adams return scenarios matter more
items.opportunity: Targets to Atwell/Mumpfield/others; Kyren Williams volume up

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs will have surgery later this week on broken ring finger and could return in as few as 2-3 weeks; IR not guaranteed, decision Saturday. Out vs Vikings before bye.
items.implication: Short-term committee; potential Week 12 return post-bye
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps to MarShawn Lloyd, Kaleb Johnson, Chris Brooks

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) did not practice Wednesday; expected to miss some time (tendon issue, short period possible). With Henderson out, Kiner next up.
items.implication: NE backfield to Kiner/Larison; bye helps recovery

items.text: Patriots ruled out RB TreVeyon Henderson for Sunday’s game in Germany against the Lions (illness).
items.implication: With Stevenson also DNP/knee issues, backfield opens wide

items.text: There are scenarios where Davante Adams (hamstring) plays and Puka Nacua (knee, toe) doesn't for some of fantasy's most important weeks. McVay: Week 12 vs Packers realistic return timeline for Adams.
items.why: Surgery recovery on shorter end; McVay optimistic
items.implication: Adams ROS boost if back for fantasy playoffs stretch; Nacua longer out
items.opportunity: Adams targets when active; interim WRs temporary

items.text: Chiefs listed QB Patrick Mahomes as a full participant in Wednesday practice, putting him on track to play Sunday at Atlanta.
items.implication: No fantasy concern; Chiefs offense full strength

items.text: Vikings positive PROE despite bad QB play; pass rate could spike with Kirk Cousins as KOC wants to throw. Expect Rams more negative PROE without Nacua and Adams. Healthy Burrow/Chase/Higgins: let them cook (positive PROE).
items.why: PROE data last 4 games + personnel changes
items.implication: Jefferson volume/efficiency up; Rams RBs up; Bengals pass game elite
items.opportunity: Jefferson routes/targets; Kyren carries; Chase/Higgins targets

items.text: I said the Vikings should bring Kirk Cousins back. If you roster Justin Jefferson, you get why. Across 54 games with Cousins, Jefferson averaging 19.6 PPR. JEFFERSON MANAGERS WE ARE SO BACK. LOVE.

Vikings acquire Kirk Cousins: Jefferson value vaults to WR1 territory (historically 106+ ypg with Cousins). Offense likely more pass-heavy. Raiders Mendoza: Bowers still elite TE1 but lower floor; Jeanty biggest loser (checkdowns).
items.why: Cousins familiarity with KOC scheme, better EPA/YPA than prior MIN QBs
items.implication: Jefferson immediate upgrade; Addison hold; Bowers/Jeanty slight downgrade
items.opportunity: Jefferson target share stable/high; Raiders RB targets down

items.text: I am KEEPING IT OPEN on Jadarian Price, even with Charb back.
items.why: Role opportunity persists despite Charbs return

items.text: Worried about Brock Bowers with Fernando Mendoza at QB? Bowers put up monster numbers as a rookie with Aidan O’Connell, Gardner Minshew and Desmond Ridder. I think he’ll be just fine.
items.why: Proven with multiple QBs as rookie
items.implication: Still start TE1; floor lower but volume safe
items.conflict: ETR notes lower floor/offense efficiency risk

items.text: Yes, the Cowboys have CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens. Yes, I’m still telling you to pick up Ryan Flournoy. There’s room for him in this offense.
items.why: Room in DAL offense despite Lamb/Pickens
items.implication: Deep league add; potential target share

items.text: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) limited in Wednesday practice; same as last week when he played and produced (8/86). Questionable but expected to play vs Pats.
items.implication: Monitor Friday report; likely WR1 as usual

items.text: Need a WR off the waiver wire? Pop Douglas is still available in 54% of leagues. He’s had an 80% route share over his last two games. I’d pick him up, and I’m fine starting him in a pinch against Detroit.
items.implication: Add and consider start in pinch
